Broken: the English word, not the people: "the broken"
City Architect: a description in lower case, "l'architecte de la cité", not the title
High Inquisitor Whitemane: "la grande inquisitrice Whitemane": the title as a description, in her gender
Lake Kel'Theril: "le lac gelé de Kel'Theril", the lake described
Mine: the English word, not a place
Old Ironforge: "les plus vieilles salles": the words, not the place
Stormwind Keep: "le donjon de Hurlevent": the city's name (Forever's French writes the keep "Donjon de Stormwind")
The Spire: Blackrock Spire, which the page calls "le pic", not the place the glossary means
Timber: the English word (wood), not Timber the wolf
